lines: During the war with Spain, the United States sent a battleship from San Francisco to Cuba.
The ship sailed all the way around South America.
After the war, the U.S. Congress decided to build a canal so that battleships could quickly sail from the Pacific Ocean to the Atlantic Ocean.
However, it was a difficult task.
The weather was too hot and damp, so many workers suffered and died.
They also had to dig miles of canal through the jungle.
Landslides often filled the holes dug by the workers, and they had to carry away huge amounts of earth.
Finally, after 10 years, it was finished in 1914.
More than 43,000 people worked on the Panama Canal.
Certainly the Panama Canal is an example of great engineering.
body.text: During the war with Spain, the United States sent a battleship from San Francisco to Cuba. The ship sailed all the way around South America. This trip was 13,000 miles. After the war, the U.S. Congress decided to build a canal so that battleships could quickly sail from the Pacific Ocean to the Atlantic Ocean. However, it was a difficult task. The weather was too hot and damp, so many workers suffered and died. They also had to dig miles of canal through the jungle. Landslides often filled the holes dug by the workers, and they had to carry away huge amounts of earth. Finally, after 10 years, it was finished in 1914. More than 43,000 people worked on the Panama Canal. It was about 52 miles long. Certainly the Panama Canal is an example of great engineering.
